```cypher
MATCH (p:Plugin {name: 'Bulk XML Export questions'})<-[:MAINTAINS]-(m:Maintainer)
OPTIONAL MATCH (m)-[:MAINTAINS]->(otherPlugin:Plugin)
WHERE otherPlugin.component <> p.component
RETURN p.component AS requestedPlugin, m.display_name AS maintainerName, COLLECT(DISTINCT otherPlugin.component) AS otherMaintainedPlugins
LIMIT 100
```
